name: Gogo 4-ji no Cinderella
source:
Yukiko, the main character whose only hobby is to drink tea elegantly at an old-fashioned cafe every Saturday. One day, made friends with a cute girl at the cafe. But something is wrong with her... she always disappears somewhere only at 4pm... What is her true identity that you happened to find out? "You, you... were you that man?"

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231001080948/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.interest.afterfour]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
主角Yukiko唯一的愛好，就是每週六到一家老式咖啡館，優雅地喝茶。某天，她在店裡結識了一位可愛的女孩。可對方似乎有點奇怪……每到下午四點，就會消失得無影無蹤……你偶然發現的她的真實身分，究竟是什麼？「你、你……原來就是那個男人？」

[譯自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231001080948/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.interest.afterfour]Google Play[/url]]
